versions.content: function  EcuM_GoHalt  [SWS_CP_SYS_00005]   Std_ReturnType EcuM_GoHalt(void); Places the microcontroller into low-power sleep mode (HALT) awaiting hardware interrupt wakeup events. BSW Mode Manager (BswM) The BswM controls mode arbitration and executes configured action lists based on logical rule evaluations.
